2607.11808.title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
2607.11808.paper_summary: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining high levels of automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.
2607.11808.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一個以人為中心的人工智慧（HCAI）框架，用於AI輔助的詞典編纂。<lb/>雖然生成式AI提供了顯著的機會來增強詞典編纂工作，但它也引發了對詞典編纂者未來角色和語言及文化多樣性保護的擔憂。<lb/>基於HCAI原則和在其他語言專業中的先前應用，本文確定了四個相互關聯的維度，通過這些維度可以理解和批判性地檢視AI在詞典編纂中的整合：增強的詞典編纂者、AI整合的社會技術背景、偏見，以及AI驅動的詞典編纂工具的設計。<lb/>該框架主張AI應該增強而不是取代詞典編纂者，結合高水平的自動化與有意義的人類控制。<lb/>它進一步強調保護專業代理權、減輕AI生成的偏見，以及圍繞詞典編纂者需求設計工具的重要性。<lb/>通過這樣做，本文為未來的研究和AI在詞典編纂工作流程中的有益整合提供了基礎。
2607.11808.author: Antonio San Martin et.al.
